problem_statement: The codebase must provide a macro named index_of(ARRAY, ELEMENT) that returns the zero-based index of an array element within an array. Given an array and a pointer to one of its elements, it must produce the element's index; for example, index_of(foo, &foo[5]) must return 5 for an unsigned array foo, and index_of(bar, &bar[17]) must return 17 for a uint8_t array bar.
